# Request Verification Service — project overview

```
Doc            : analysis/platform/PROJECT-OVERVIEW.md
Role           : the active profile in one page — what every stage, gate and consumer of THIS project builds against
Generated from : project.yaml + profiles/aias.yaml, by `gov.py render`
Project id     : aias
```

Standalone backend service that verifies a government service request before an employee approves it — runs the service's configured read-only queries, fetches and reads the attached documents, compares them with the service's conditions, and returns a stored, evidence-backed compliance report. The employee stays the decision maker.
